 UEFA Champions League Comments Manchester United vs Roma: Confirmed lineups for the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League match
 By World Soccer Talk 
 Updated on 
November 03, 2026 
 Follow us on Google! © Alamy Diogo Dalot of Manchester United Manchester United host Roma at a time when both clubs need a Champions League result to settle some nerves, and the contrast in how they arrive here gives this fixture its edge. Manchester United come into this one on a two-game skid, having lost 1-4 to Como 1907 on October 21 after a 0-2 defeat to Atlético on October 13. Those two results have piled pressure on Michael Carrick, and the goals conceded in bunches point to problems at the back that have not been fixed. A win here would steady the ship, while another loss would deepen the concern around this group. Roma arrive in better shape, having bounced back from a 3-4 loss to Real Madrid on October 14 with a 4-0 win over Slovan on October 20. That victory showed Gian Piero Gasperini’s side can still score freely when things click going forward. Taking points off United would mark real progress in their European campaign and answer any doubts left by the Madrid defeat. Add as a preferred source on Google Manchester United confirmed lineup
 Carrick sets United up in a 4-2-3-1, with Dalot and Mazraoui as the full-backs either side of Maguire and Martínez at center-back. Tielemans and Mainoo sit in a double pivot screening the defense, while Bruno Fernandes gets license to roam behind Mbeumo, Mount and Cunha in a fluid front four built around Mbeumo’s pace on the right. There are no absences to work around, so this is as close to a first-choice group as Carrick can put out, which makes the recent defensive form harder to explain away. Manchester United confirmed starting XI (4-2-3-1): Senne Lammens, Leny Yoro, Diogo Dalot, Carlos Baleba, Harry Maguire, Ayden Heaven, Bryan Mbeumo, Kobbie Mainoo, Matheus Cunha, Bruno Fernandes, Amad Diallo. Coach: Michael Carrick. Roma confirmed lineup
 Gasperini goes with his trusted 3-4-2-1, built on a back three of Ndicka, Mancini and Hermoso shielding goalkeeper Vásquez. Molina and Wesley França provide width as wing-backs, with Cristante and De Roon controlling the center of the pitch, and Pisilli given a free role just behind the front line. Soulé and Malen support central striker Malen’s spearhead role, giving Roma the same attacking pattern that produced the win over Slovan. With a clean bill of health, Gasperini can call on his first-choice XI to try to disrupt United at Old Trafford. Advertisement Advertisement Roma confirmed starting XI (3-4-2-1): Devis Vásquez, Devyne Rensch, Wesley, Mario Hermoso, Leonardo Balerdi, Gianluca Mancini, Bryan Cristante, Marten de Roon, Donyell Malen, Rodrigo Mora, Matías Soulé.
